findings.title: Existing stable API members are deleted without versioned removal

applicableGuidance.excerpt: To remove models, properties, or operations starting from a specific version, use the @removed decorator. The version argument is the version where the element is removed.
TypeSpec uses a versioning library that models the changes in each new version of the API. This works well when APIs evolve according to versioning guidelines, without breaking changes.

findings.expected: To remove models, properties, or operations starting from a specific version, use the @removed decorator. The version argument is the version where the element is removed.
findings.actual: The change directly deletes @added(Versions.v2026_12_06) NFS file fields and their supporting item models from the existing stable version.
findings.gap: The fetched versioning guidance requires API changes to be represented across versions without breaking existing clients. Direct deletion changes the already selected stable 2026-12-06 contract instead of introducing a later version and applying @removed there.
